name: AXM Audio Studio
summary: One local-first workspace for tracks, sound design, synthesis, deterministic headless SFX baking, scoring, spatial audio, voice, restoration and generative music.
notes: The preserved Sound Forge engine is integrated as Sound Lab. Its governed SFX Bake back half turns axm.audio.sound/v1 parameters into deterministic WAV bytes without automatic writes. Generated sources render locally; session-only imported audio is never falsely claimed in a mix.
